## Laboratory Scope & Wire Filtering
- Role: Ingress socket filtering, XDP/eBPF packet boundary tests, and early triage benchmarks.
- In-Kernel Frame Clamping: Validates socket-layer packet dropping (SO_ATTACH_BPF / XDP) enforcing S_max <= 4096B envelopes before user-space memory is allocated.
- Triage Lattice Benchmarking: Evaluates line-rate pre-ingress mapping over the 5-element join-semilattice (L) into POSIX signals:
  BREACH (40) > REFUSAL (32) > CORRUPT (30) > PWC (12) > PASS (0).
- FREEZE Isolation: Tests scheduling yield behavior outside Im(Phi) ensuring rate-limiting clamps (tau_override <= 11.99ms) cannot be externally parameterized by ingress payload content.
